| Stat | San Diego | Sea Watch |
|---|---|---|
| **Win Rate** | 36% | 11% |
| **Avg TPA/Day** | 1.48 | 0.96 |
| **Price** | $250 | $150 |
| **Departs** | 5:30 AM | 7:00 AM |
| **Open Spots** | 19/36 | 29/35 |
| **Forecast** | 7.0/10 | 7.0/10 |

**Quick translation:**
- **Win Rate** = % of head-to-head matchups won against peer boats on the same trip length/day. [San Diego](#boat/San%20Diego) wins 36 of every 100 → more than 3x [Sea Watch](#boat/Sea%20Watch)'s 11%.
- **TPA/Day** = Trophy fish Per Angler per Day. San Diego puts 1.48 trophies in each angler's bag vs Sea Watch's 0.96 — roughly 50% more fish per rod.

**Bottom line:** San Diego is the clear producer. You're paying $100 more, but the performance gap is massive and she leaves 90 minutes earlier for a longer fishing day. Sea Watch is the budget call if $150 is the ceiling.
